additional_questions.title: Explicit assertion and execution support
additional_questions.question: Accept the additional assertion-interpretation, observation/checker and separate assertion/execution provenance duties at these exact proof consumers, preserving their existing authority, scope and lane restrictions?
additional_questions.i5_consequences_to_assess: Source-first comparison and receiving-line review must cover each actual proof consumer. A correct source identifier or executed test is not by itself the additional support.

additional_questions.title: Mutual assurance and shared failure causes
additional_questions.question: Accept the explicit shared-cause and provenance conditions on mutual-assurance claims while retaining frame separation, logical conjunction and required authorship independence?
additional_questions.i5_consequences_to_assess: Inspect shared fixtures, interpretations, observations and received contributions. Agreement and different actors do not establish statistical independence.

additional_questions.title: Risk-qualified assurance selection
additional_questions.question: Accept the extended impact/risk/total-cost selection duties, required new coverage and mandatory gates, and the model/dependence/calibration conditions on quantitative assurance?
additional_questions.i5_consequences_to_assess: Assess actual selection and unsupported exclusions; retain qualitative evidence and unknown numeric estimates. No universal probability threshold or automatic full-suite cadence follows.

additional_questions.title: Predictive claims and required outcomes
additional_questions.question: Accept the added mandatory assertion/observation binding for world-model assurance and the distinction between predictive adequacy and construction outcome satisfaction, retaining the original advisory list strength?
additional_questions.i5_consequences_to_assess: Review the model-purpose and observation binding and the material construction consumer; do not equate prediction error with an outcome failure.

additional_questions.title: Construction strategy and feedback obligations
additional_questions.question: Accept the added required-state/prediction/observation, strategy/resource and feedback/preservation duties at the delegated construction consumer while retaining the old lawful execution and authority boundaries?
additional_questions.i5_consequences_to_assess: Assess the current construction and recovery joins, supported continuation and resource rationale; preserve optional strategies and unresolved universal proofs.

standing: Twelve proposed conserved-to-superseded changes and one revision of a pending proposal. Historical evidence and all owner decisions remain unchanged and open.
